description: React component for the Workflows Page that manages workflows data fetching, filtering, sorting, and UI rendering including table display and error handling.

methods.name: fetchWorkflows
methods.description: Fetches workflows data from API, handles pagination, resets, and error state updates.

methods.name: handleWorkflowClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a workflow to navigate to its detail page.

methods.name: handleSortChange
methods.description: Updates sorting criteria for workflows table.

methods.name: handleLoadMore
methods.description: Loads additional workflows for pagination when requested.

methods.name: handleWorkflowsDeleted
methods.description: Refreshes workflows list when workflows are deleted.
